participant_bootstrap.adjusted_family: Three full-MIRA-minus-component-control B50-linear macro-F1 contrasts only
participant_bootstrap.scope: Conditional on fixed fitted models, calibration, selected recordings, environments/cohorts and masks; excludes new-room and retraining uncertainty.

component_seed_effects.condition: contiguous 50 percent loss with linear repair
component_seed_effects.estimator: Full minus control macro F1, paired within training seed after the existing average of five masks; mean and sample SD use five seed differences.
component_seed_effects.scope: Descriptive seed variation; not confidence intervals, new participant samples, or a guarantee under future retraining. The existing conditional participant-bootstrap analysis and weights were not changed.
component_seed_effects.mask_distance_identity: m_t = I[d_t = 0]; the zero-mask-input control tests an explicit encoding, not removal of missingness information.

counting_note: All seeds, masks and bootstrap replicates reuse the same 1260 recordings from 30 people. Probability-vector and scalar-check counts are not sample sizes.
initial_release_note: v0.1.0 contains the original 60-fit comparison, not the new 90-fit component checkpoints. MIRA B50 accuracy 23.00 percent is the original five paired-seed summary; 22.56 percent is the follow-up full mask grid.
evidence_scope: Arithmetic verification does not establish universal novelty, state-of-the-art superiority or deployment readiness.
